provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Mansions of Madness Second Edition rules summary (The Esoteric Order of Gamers)

steps.text: Shuffle the damage and horror decks separately, facedown
Common item, unique item, spell and condition decks sorted alphabetically, faceup
Map tiles sorted by size; monsters with their tokens; tokens in pools by type
Run the app, enable your expansions, choose NEW GAME and pick a story together
Each player picks an investigator card and figure and enters it in the app
Take the starting possessions the app lists and share them out as you like
Read the prologue aloud; place the starting map tile, figures and tokens as the app shows
Investigator phase: each investigator takes a turn, then press END PHASE
